commands:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
EXPECTED=3b331791d6ea2a372f42dd4cb3746af26441cd29
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "$EXPECTED"
git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' '=== CURRENT IAS EMULATOR PATH ==='
grep -n -A35 -B12 'ias_zone_status = ias_zone_status' tests/zigbee_device_emulator/main/emulator_main.c || true
printf '%s\n' '=== EZBEE / ESP ZIGBEE IAS HEADERS AND SOURCES ==='
ROOTS=(tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components managed_components components "$HOME/esp" "$HOME/.espressif")
for root in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do
  [ -e "$root" ] || continue
  echo ROOT=$root
  grep -RniE --include='*.h' --include='*.c' --include='*.cpp' --include='*.cc' --include='*.inc' '(zone[ _-]*status.*change|status[ _-]*change.*zone|ias_zone.*status|ZONE_STATUS_CHANGE|IAS_ZONE_STATUS|status_change_notification|zone_status_change)' "$root" 2>/dev/null | head -n 500 || true
done
printf '%s\n' '=== IAS PUBLIC SYMBOL CANDIDATES IN BUILT LIBRARIES ==='
find tests/zigbee_device_emulator/build build "$HOME/.espressif" "$HOME/esp" -type f \( -name '*.a' -o -name '*.so' -o -name '*.dylib' \) 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  nm -g "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(ias.*zone.*status|zone.*status.*change|status.*change.*notif)' && echo LIB=$f || true
done | head -n 300
printf '%s\n' '=== IAS HEADER FILES ==='
find tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components managed_components components "$HOME/esp" "$HOME/.espressif" -type f \( -iname '*ias*zone*.h' -o -iname '*zcl*ias*.h' \) 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -n 100
printf '%s\n' '=== DECISION ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
print('INVESTIGATION_COMPLETE=1')
print('REPORT_REQUIRED: exact callable API/signature (if any) for IAS Zone Status Change Notification; whether EZBee exposes it; whether esp_zigbee exposes a lower-level public API; and the smallest standards-correct way to emit both ZoneStatus 0x0001 and 0x0000 after enrollment. Do not modify files.')
PY
git status --short
